questions.q: What are the three post types available in the Chatter publisher?
options: Post, Poll, and Question
Email, Task, and Event
Note, File, and Link
Update, Alert, and Reminder
questions.explain: The Chatter publisher offers Post (a plain update), Poll (a quick vote), and Question (a post others can answer).

questions.q: What is the key difference between a Private and an Unlisted Chatter group?
options: There is no difference — the terms are interchangeable
A Private group is visible in search but requires approval to join; an Unlisted group is hidden from search entirely
A Private group can only have 10 members; Unlisted has no limit
Unlisted groups cannot have a feed, only Private groups can
questions.explain: Private groups show up in search (joining needs an invite or approval); Unlisted groups don't appear in search at all — the owner or manager must add members directly.

questions.q: Where does an admin configure which fields automatically post a change to a record's Chatter feed?
options: Setup → Email-to-Case Settings
A permission set's System Permissions
Object Manager → [Object] → Feed Tracking
The Lightning App Builder
questions.explain: Feed Tracking is configured per object in Object Manager, where an admin picks up to 20 fields whose changes automatically post to that record's feed.

questions.q: How is Feed Tracking different from Field History Tracking?
options: They are the exact same feature under two different names
Field History Tracking only works in Salesforce Classic
Feed Tracking requires a paid add-on license; Field History Tracking is always free
Feed Tracking generates a social feed post for anyone following the record; Field History Tracking keeps a permanent audit record instead
questions.explain: Feed Tracking is a lighter-weight, social companion to Field History Tracking — one surfaces changes in the feed for followers, the other maintains a permanent, queryable history record.

questions.q: By default, is Chatter turned on or off in a new Salesforce org?
options: Off — an admin must explicitly enable it in Setup before any user can post
On — Chatter is enabled by default, and Chatter Settings in Setup is where an admin adjusts it
It depends entirely on which edition of Salesforce the org has
On, but only for System Administrator profiles
questions.explain: Chatter ships enabled by default in new orgs; Setup → Chatter Settings is where an admin turns specific Chatter features on or off, not where Chatter itself gets switched on for the first time.
